# Synthetic child-name fixture for the six createChild functions; no game data.
# The ordinary unit exercises random names; this fixture builds coherent SafeStrings: the actual
# name (descriptor +0x14) and the three expected child names point to two 0x40002-byte buffers of
# 'A' whose bytes at 0x40000 pick 0 or 'A' (byte 0x40001 is 0): equal names that end exactly at
# the 0x40001-byte comparison cap, names that run past it, unequal last bytes, and the pointer-
# equality fast path. The termination callback (vtable +0x14 -> 01000300) may re-point the
# string it terminates to either buffer, and may re-point the actual name (descriptor +0x14) too,
# so the order of termination, text reads and comparison matters.
src wwhd_src/d/hd_screen_secret_entrance_chart.cpp
src wwhd_src/d/hd_screen_squid_chart.cpp
src wwhd_src/d/hd_screen_submarine_chart.cpp
src wwhd_src/d/hd_screen_terry_chart.cpp
src wwhd_src/d/hd_screen_tingle_tower_chart.cpp
src wwhd_src/d/hd_screen_triforce_chart.cpp
stackfill periodic
callee 01000300 r3=8
mockfield 01000300 r3+0 u32 0x56000000,0x57000000
mockglobal 01000300 55000014 u32 0x56000000,0x57000000
stable 55000000 0x20
stable 55001000 0x20
stable 56000000 0x40002
stable 57000000 0x40002
